Title: Azure Functions—Direct export of Azure Functions for PowerApps

Body.Content:
Direct export of Azure Functions APIs to PowerApps or Microsoft Flow from the Azure portal will soon be supported. This will create a seamless experience within the Azure portal to expose APIs more broadly within the organization. Previously, customers needed to use the PowerApps or Microsoft Flow web portals to import custom APIs from Azure Functions or Azure App Service. Users will be able to stay within the Azure portal experience to complete the entire process of retrieving API definitions and exporting to PowerApps and Microsoft Flow.

Learn more about using Azure Functions in PowerApps.
